name: Cubic Hermite Interpolation
aliases: Cubic Hermite Interpolation — Third Order Polynomial
definition: A cubic polynomial p(x) = a0 + a1*x + a2*x^2 + a3*x^3 used to interpolate the four Hermite constraints (two values, two derivatives).
summary: Cubic Hermite Interpolation determines precise isovertex positions by fitting a cubic polynomial to function values and gradients, offering higher accuracy than linear interpolation for non-linear implicit functions.
